text:
Lena (Sales): Hi finance - my company card was declined when I tried to buy an eSIM data plan at the airport kiosk in Madrid. I paid €30 on my personal card to top up because I needed connectivity for customer calls. Can I get reimbursed for the eSIM purchase + the 2.5% foreign card fee my bank charged?
expense-bot: Reminder: Attach merchant receipt and personal card statement for non-company-card charges. Include explanation why corporate card couldn't be used.
Lena (Sales): attaching photo of the eSIM receipt (shows product 'eSIM 5GB - €30') and a screenshot of my card showing a €30.75 posted amount (2.5% FX/processing). Also a photo of the airport kiosk screen showing chip reader error when I tried the corp card.
Elaine (Finance): Thanks. Policy: data plans required for business travel are reimbursable. FX/bank fees are reimbursed only when the employee had no reasonable alternative and the fee is under €10. Please add a short note in the expense form describing attempts to use corp card and why it failed.
Lena (Sales): added note: "tapped corp card - terminal returned 'declined'; cashier suggested chip reader issue; used personal card to avoid missed calls."
Mateo (IT Travel): we've seen intermittent issues with card tokenization at some EU kiosks. Filing ticket with payments team, but for now we should treat these as valid exceptions when documentation provided.
Ravi (Manager): I approve the reimbursement. This was business-critical.
Elaine (Finance): Great. Two small asks: 1) Please upload a cropped screenshot of the personal card posting that shows the merchant name and the posted €30.75. 2) Change expense category to "Connectivity - Travel" so it maps to telecom spend.
Lena (Sales): uploaded cropped screenshot and changed category.
expense-bot: Expense created: "eSIM data top-up - MAD airport" status: awaiting approval. Link: https://expenses.internal/reports/EXP-3333
Elaine (Finance): I'll approve €30.75 (fare + bank fee) conditionally. Rafael (Finance Ops) will mark FX fee as 'exception reimbursable' since there was a documented corp-card decline. Expect payment in 3-5 business days.
Lena (Sales): thank you! Quick Q: if the corp card keeps failing at EU kiosks, can travel issue virtual cards be provisioned?
Mateo (IT Travel): yes. If a team has repeated declines we can issue a region-specific virtual card for travel. Send me a list of terminals/airports affected and I'll track patterns.
Elaine (Finance): Flagging case FIN-2026-190 for audit trail. Closing here once payment completes.
Lena (Sales): appreciated - will DM the terminals list to Mateo. :thumbsup:
expense-bot: Payment scheduled: EXP-3333 -> Lena (Personal Reimbursement) amount €30.75. ETA 5 biz days.
